subject: Talent ops vendor timeline & risk matrix
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priya Shah <account@greenhouse.io>, Ethan Rossi <sales@checkr.com>, Aisha Nader <cs@learnio.com>
Date: Sun, 17 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Talent ops vendor timeline & risk matrix

Hi all,

We're starting a quick consolidation for the talent stack renewals that are clustered this summer (Greenhouse, Checkr, Learnio). Goal is to have a single timeline and a lightweight risk matrix so Procurement and Finance know the negotiation windows and compliance gaps.

What I need from vendor partners this week:
- Confirm contract end-date and earliest renewal month (if auto-renew windows exist)
- Current list pricing + any available discounts for multi-product commitment
- Security/compliance evidence (SOC 2 report, encryption in transit/storage, SSO/SAML support)
- A single-line SOW or pricing stub we can attach to the matrix

Vendors: please reply with those items as attachments where possible. Internal owners: Laura, can you take Greenhouse; Marissa, can you take Learnio; Vivek I'll loop you when we have material to escalate.

I've attached a starter sheet (vendor-risk-matrix-20260517.xlsx) — please update your tab with timelines and flag any hard stops.

Thanks,
Neha
Neha Kapoor
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0192

Attachments: vendor-risk-matrix-20260517.xlsx

From: Priya Shah <account@greenhouse.io>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Talent ops vendor timeline & risk matrix

Hi Neha / team,

Thanks for the note — Priya here from Greenhouse. Quick responses below and I've attached a draft SOW and our standard renewal timeline:

- Contract term: current term ends 2026-08-31. Renewal window opens 60 days prior.
- Pricing: I'll attach our current price sheet and include a 12% multi-product discount proposal if you bundle Greenhouse Hire + Onboarding.
- Compliance: SOC 2 Type II report (most recent), SAML + SCIM supported; we can provide an ATO checklist.
- SOW: attached (greenhouse_sow_draft_may2026.docx) — this is a starting point.

I added a couple notes in your matrix tab (timeline rows). If you want, we can schedule a 30-min sync to run through the SOW changes and any SSO gaps.

Best,
Priya Shah
Enterprise Account Lead, Greenhouse
account@greenhouse.io

Attachments: greenhouse_sow_draft_may2026.docx

From: Ethan Rossi <sales@checkr.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Talent ops vendor timeline & risk matrix

Neha — appreciate the heads-up. Forwarding our proposal and SOC 2 bundle.

- Contract: annual agreement; current renewal date 2026-07-15. We recommend locking pricing by June 15 for Q3 start.
- Pricing: attached (checkr_proposal_may2026.pdf). We can offer 10% off base background-check unit pricing if Redwood commits for 12 months.
- Compliance: SOC 2 Type II + vendor security questionnaire PDF included.

One note on volume: if you expect a 30% uptick in hires in Q3 we should price-band the units so you don't get surprise overages. Happy to jump on a call to walk through.

Regards,
Ethan Rossi
Enterprise Sales, Checkr
sales@checkr.com

Attachments: checkr_proposal_may2026.pdf

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <account@greenhouse.io>, Ethan Rossi <sales@checkr.com>, Aisha Nader <cs@learnio.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Talent ops vendor timeline & risk matrix

Thanks for the fast responses, Priya and Ethan — useful attachments. I pulled the key dates into a single timeline and attached an updated risk matrix with initial risk ratings per vendor. Quick summary (from the sheet):

- Greenhouse: Renewal 2026-08-31, medium risk (SSO config work + minor contract language asks). Action: Laura to own SSO test plan; Priya to confirm SCIM provisioning timeline.
- Checkr: Renewal 2026-07-15, medium-high risk (pricing bands + volume assumptions). Action: Procurement to lock volume bands; Ethan to confirm overage thresholds.
- Learnio: contract end 2026-09-01, low risk but pricing misalignment with seats vs expected users. Marissa to confirm active seat usage and negotiate per-seat vs per-active-user.

Action items and owners:
1) Laura: run SSO test (target complete 2026-06-15) — need test account from Greenhouse.
2) Marissa: usage export for Learnio (due 2026-05-26).
3) Neha: coordinate consolidated negotiation deck for Finance (draft due 2026-06-01).
4) Procurement: recommend locking Checkr pricing by 2026-06-15 to avoid Q3 rate exposure.

I've attached vendor-risk-matrix-20260517.xlsx (updated). Please add comments directly in the sheet. If we don't have material changes by next Friday (2026-05-28) we'll set a 30-min alignment with vendors to finalize SOWs and discount asks.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Talent Ops | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Attachments: vendor-risk-matrix-20260517.xlsx

This looks good — thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. A few notes from leadership:

- Prioritize SOC 2 reports and SSO completion for Greenhouse before we finalize any onboarding modules; security gating is non-negotiable.
- Approve negotiation authority: Procurement (Neha) can negotiate up to 12% on list if it includes multi-product commitments; above that requires Finance approval.
- For Checkr, lock the volume bands as recommended by Laura to avoid exposure. If procurement can get the 10% off Ethan proposed, approve moving ahead.

Neha/Laura: please set a 30-min meeting with all three vendors next week (suggested window: Tue 2026-05-25 10:00-12:00 PT) and send invites. Marissa: please have the Learnio usage export on the sheet ahead of that meeting.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
